claimRule: A stored or same-process handoff is not FRESH_SESSION_GREEN. Synthetic/local fresh-process success does not certify the real case, production auth, ChatGPT registration, or a real new-chat tool call.

layers.evidence: Canonical immutable packets freeze state, diff, exact episode, pending candidates, transcript archive, tracker/journal, retrieval indexes, and constitution/runtime/audit references with component and chunk integrity.

Handoffs use separate AES-256-GCM dual-wrap envelopes, mode-0600 files, a mode-0700 private root, authorization-before-key access, and no plaintext fallback. The available credential/key provider is explicitly development-only.
Independent Session B received only handoff_id plus normal test transport authorization and reconstructed the exact packet after Session A exited.

Session B preserved constitution version, target/path, stop/switch/stay conditions, contradictions, mixed trajectory, hypotheses, settled answers, failed paths, consent/method state, and an exact pending candidate; its deterministic decision projection equaled Session A.
Synthetic history exceeded 100,000 characters and the exact packet used deterministic contiguous chunks no larger than 20,000 UTF-8 bytes.
Store/access/MCP operations cover handoff, live context, state diff, recent exact episode, pending candidate, targeted older evidence, tracker, journal, candidate, and exact source retrieval.
Candidate text round-tripped byte-exactly by handoff and stable candidate ID; the existing fresh-process audit adapter resolved exact private candidate text before audit.
Wrong bearer and wrong routine key failed clearly without leaking the private synthetic marker or returning a public/de-identified substitute.

Current Saved State, What Changed This Turn, Create Handoff, and encrypted export are wired. UI language withholds completion before FRESH_SESSION_GREEN, and blocked packets show continuation failures.
Local publication audit scanned 158,932 records with zero findings; synthetic payload markers were absent from tracked files and encrypted handoff exports.

The real private episode is exact and complete from its declared semantic start through the latest turn. The immutable handoff was loaded in a separate process using only handoff_id plus ambient authorization, with exact recent and candidate text.
